why: Whether the 1000 mm rule applies is unknown, but the door meets it either way. KNOWN LIMIT: the agent's check treats an unknown condition as needs_human.

spec.name: Wheelchair door exactly 1000 mm, design speed not given

exterior_doors.wheelchair_door_clear_wid.required: ≥ 1000 mm if design speed < 250 km/h, else ≥ 800 mm; 1000 mm meets both
exterior_doors.wheelchair_door_clear_wid.rationale: If the speed is below 250 km/h, 4.2.2.3.2(2) applies and 1000 ≥ 1000; otherwise only (1) applies and 1000 ≥ 800. The outcome does not depend on the missing speed. Expected to be missed: `check` returns needs_human whenever a condition is unknown, even when both branches pass. A person would call it a pass; the tool is more cautious.
